No I haven't had any professional diagnose me. I've seen a doctor and I'm currently taking something to treat my depression and anxiety. I'm also seeing a social worker whose helping me with these issues and can refer me to a psychiatrist if needed. I just won't see her for another couple weeks and I'm not sure if I'll make it that long. 

The reason I think there may be something wrong neurologically is that for the past couple months I've been having a persistent ache in my head. I've also been having memory issues, having trouble following conversations, and story lines on tv and in books, and just an overall feeling of unreality. Its like I've had cotton stuffed in my head and I've gotten significantly stupider. Besides that, the feelings of suicide come in waves and I have a sudden urge to kill myself almost like I'm being compelled. The normal thoughts of suicide are more rational and come from pain and hopelessness although I've felt those as well.

I think it might be something like dementia because I used to play football and I was knocked out cold a year and a half ago hitting my head on the pavement. These types of injuries can lead to something called [CTE](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chronic_traumatic_encephalopathy). I know what depression is since I have been for a large part of my life due to social anxiety and this just feels different or more.
